english.title: Remove a rail / sleeper to obstruct / destroy an engine / carriage using the railway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) unlawfully and maliciously took up, removed or displaced a rail, sleeper, matter of thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ITEM(S)..) belonging to the railway with intent to obstruct, upset, overthrow, injure or destroy any engine, tender, carriage or truck using the railway at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35 of the Malicious Damage Act 1861.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) If there was any INTENT TO ENDANGER ANY PERSON using the railway, an offence of obstructing the railway with intent to endanger life under section 32 of the Offences Against the Person Act 1861 should be charged - H734 refers.
(ii) See also offence wording: H733 re intent to endanger the safety of a person travelling on the railway.
